bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; requiring disqualification from operating a commercial motor vehicle after commission of certain offenses involving a commercial motor vehicle; imposing civil penalties; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.165, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.165, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 2a.+]

[+Use of commercial motor vehicle in certain offenses; disqualification for life.+]

[+The commissioner must disqualify a person from operating a commercial motor vehicle for life if the person uses a commercial motor vehicle in the commission of the following offenses: +]

[+(1) a felony violation involving the manufacture, distribution, or dispensing of a controlled substance, or possession with the intent to manufacture, distribute, or dispense a controlled substance under chapter 152; or +]

[+(2) a felony violation involving a forced or coerced labor or services or human trafficking-related offense under section 609.281, subdivision 4; 609.282; or 609.322, subdivision 1 or 1a. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to offenses committed on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; requiring disqualification from operating a commercial motor vehicle after commission of certain offenses involving a commercial motor vehicle; imposing civil penalties; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.165, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.165, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 2a.

Use of commercial motor vehicle in certain offenses; disqualification for life.

The commissioner must disqualify a person from operating a commercial motor vehicle for life if the person uses a commercial motor vehicle in the commission of the following offenses:

(1) a felony violation involving the manufacture, distribution, or dispensing of a controlled substance, or possession with the intent to manufacture, distribute, or dispense a controlled substance under chapter 152; or

(2) a felony violation involving a forced or coerced labor or services or human trafficking-related offense under section 609.281, subdivision 4; 609.282; or 609.322, subdivision 1 or 1a.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to offenses committed on or after that date.
additions: Use of commercial motor vehicle in certain offenses; disqualification for life.
The commissioner must disqualify a person from operating a commercial motor vehicle for life if the person uses a commercial motor vehicle in the commission of the following offenses:

(1) a felony violation involving the manufacture, distribution, or dispensing of a controlled substance, or possession with the intent to manufacture, distribute, or dispense a controlled substance under chapter 152; or
(2) a felony violation involving a forced or coerced labor or services or human trafficking-related offense under section 609.281, subdivision 4; 609.282; or 609.322, subdivision 1 or 1a.
This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to offenses committed on or after that date.
